posts.t: With 6:14 to go, Slafkovsky gets a holding call...you can't give the refs the opportunity to make that call. #goHabsGo
Matheson passes to Slafkovsky, who tries to clear, but it goes the other way, through Bedard, 1-0 Hawks #GoHabsGo

If the Canadiens are to weather the storm that is the Suzuki injury, they'll need their best players to step up and that includes Juraj Slafkovsky, the latest in my article for @Thehockeynews: thehockeynews.com/nhl/montreal... #GoHabsGo #CH #Canadiens #Habs #THN

Canadiens forward lines unchanged at practice today, with Oliver Kapanen taking Juraj Slafkovský's spot on the top line. Slafkovský is undergoing treatment (presumably for the collision in Washington). That doesn't necessarily bode well for Kapanen's chances to make his season debut tomorrow.
